description:
## Why This Exists

store/server_stores.rs constructs AuthFailureTracker with hardcoded parameters: max_failures=10, window=60s, max_entries=DEFAULT_MAX_ENTRIES. These values are not configurable via the config file. Operators cannot tune the per-IP lockout policy to match their security posture.

In contrast, session-level MAX_AUTH_FAILURES (5) controls per-session limits and is defined in context.rs.

## Acceptance Criteria

Expose AuthFailureTracker parameters (max_failures, window_secs) in the [auth] config section. Document defaults. The current hardcoded values become the defaults.
title: auth_failure_tracker hardcoded window 10/60s; not configurable
